expression:
case_when(
  !(as.character(.wave) %in% c("2003", "2005", "2007", "2009", "2011")) ~ NA_character_,
  as.numeric(asthma_told) %in% 2 ~ "Never diagnosed",
  as.numeric(asthma_told) %in%
    1 &
    (as.numeric(asthma_episode_12m) %in% c(2, 3) | as.numeric(asthma_still) %in% 2) ~ "Currently diagnosed",
  as.numeric(asthma_told) %in%
    1 &
    (as.numeric(asthma_episode_12m) %in% 1 | as.numeric(asthma_still) %in% 3) ~ "Previously diagnosed",
  .default = NA_character_
)
notes: 2003-2011 only. Self-report on asthma alone: 'Has a doctor or nurse ever told you that you have asthma?' (asthma_told) with a current-status item, 2003-2005 'During the past 12 months, have you had an episode of asthma or an asthma attack?' (asthma_episode_12m: told and 'I do not have asthma' = Previously; told and has asthma, with or without an episode = Currently) and 2007-2011 'Do you still have asthma?' (asthma_still: told and No = Previously, told and Yes = Currently). Not told = Never; not sure, missing, or told with a current answer of not sure or 'never had asthma' = NA. 2013-2019 ask the ever-told item alone, a binary item that does not fill waves of a row whose other waves separate current from previous diagnosis, so NA and unused there; 1999 asks neither. Partial: one condition only.
